detail.historyDescription: Everything administration recorded about this account, newest action first.
detail.noHistory: No actions recorded for this account.
detail.sessionsEnded: Your sessions were ended. Sign in again to continue.
detail.viewHistory: View actions recorded for this account
detail.accessDescription: What this account can do on the instance. Every action requires a reason and is recorded.
detail.suspendDescription: The account loses its session now and cannot sign in until reactivated.
detail.selfSuspend: You cannot suspend your own account.
detail.sessionsDescription: Disconnects the account from every device. It remains active and can sign in again.
detail.selfSessions: This ends your own session: you will need to sign in again.
detail.administrationDescription: Who can see and operate the entire instance: users, servers, reports and audit.
detail.removeAdminDescription: Removing the role makes it a regular account. The last active administrator cannot be removed.
detail.selfAdmin: You cannot remove your own administration.
detail.grantAdminDescription: Do this only for someone you trust: the account can operate the entire instance.
detail.activeOnlyAdmin: Only an active account can become an administrator.
detail.deleteDescription: Permanent. Servers it owns go to the longest-standing member; servers with no other members are deleted. Sent messages remain in history.
detail.selfDelete: You cannot delete your own account.
detail.suspendDialog: @{{username}} loses its session now and cannot sign in until reactivated.
detail.revokeDialog: Ends every session and connection for @{{username}}. The account remains active.
detail.grantDialog: @{{username}} can see and operate the entire instance: users, servers, reports and audit. Do this only for someone you trust.
detail.revokeAdminDialog: @{{username}} becomes a regular account. The last active administrator cannot be removed.
detail.deleteDialog: Permanent. Servers it owns go to the longest-standing member; servers with no other members are deleted. Sent messages remain in history.
detail.serversDescription: The servers this account is in, and whether it owns each one.

entity.historyServerDescription: Everything the administration recorded about this server, newest first.
entity.noServerHistory: No actions recorded for this server.
entity.serverMembersDescription: Who is in the server. You review and act on it without joining.
entity.channelsDescription: The server's channels, in the order they appear.
entity.suspendedServerDescription: Reason: “{{reason}}”. Nobody can read, write, download media or join a call.
entity.suspendServerDescription: Members still see the server in their list, but nobody can read, write, download media or join a call. Ongoing calls are ended.
entity.deleteServerDescription: Permanent: deletes the server, its channels, messages and files. This cannot be undone.
entity.serverOwnerAssignment: {{current}} New owner: @{{username}}. The previous owner becomes a member. You do not join the server.
entity.historyWebhookDescription: Everything the administration recorded about this webhook, newest first.
entity.noWebhookHistory: No actions recorded for this webhook.
entity.webhookTokenNote: The token is never shown here: only someone who manages the channel sees the URL, when generating it.
entity.revokeWebhookDescription: The current URL stops working right away. To receive posts again, someone who manages the channel must generate a new URL.
entity.revokeWebhookDialog: The current URL stops working right away. Someone who manages the channel must generate a new one to receive posts again.

report.evidenceDescription: The text as it was when the report was sent. It is not the current conversation.
report.truncated: The text was truncated when saved; the complete original is not available here.
report.author: Author
report.targetDescription: This report stores no content: the target is identified by name and ID.
report.name: Name
report.decisionDescription: Choose the outcome, review its effect and confirm with a reason. Nothing happens before confirmation.
report.claimDescription: The report moves to “In review” with you as the assignee.
report.historyDescription: Review, resolution and applied action, newest first.
report.noActionEffect: Closes as resolved without any action on the target.
report.dismissEffect: Closes the report as unfounded without any action on the target.
report.suspendUserEffect: The account loses its session now and cannot sign in until reactivated.
report.deleteMessageEffect: The message is removed for everyone; the report snapshot remains.
report.suspendServerEffect: Members can no longer read, write or join calls until it is reactivated.

common.instanceStateDescription: Values read now, without history: the panel does not measure time series.
common.refreshFailed: Could not refresh. The values below are from the read at {{time}}.
common.servicesDescription: What is configured and queued. This is not a health check.

pages.users: Accounts on this instance: search, filter, and open one to moderate it, change its role, or delete it.
pages.servers: Every server on this instance, with its owner, members and status.
pages.webhooks: Channel webhooks: which server they post to, who created them and whether they are active.
pages.reports: What people reported. Open a report to claim it, see the evidence and decide.
pages.audit: Everything administrators and the system itself did: who, to what, when and why.
pages.system: The state of the instance right now: connections, storage, accounts, services and maintenance.

system.graceAny: only files old enough are considered (recent ones may be uploads in progress)
system.graceHours_one: only files older than {{count}} hour are considered (newer ones may be uploads in progress)
system.graceHours_other: only files older than {{count}} hours are considered (newer ones may be uploads in progress)
system.graceMinutes: only files older than {{count}} minutes are considered (newer ones may be uploads in progress)
system.storageNoLimit: {{used}} in use. The storage limit was not reported.
system.sweepRecent: {{count}} recent one(s) spared by the grace period.
system.sweepMissing: {{count}} database record(s) with no file on disk (reported only, nothing is done).
system.signupsPaused: Sign-ups paused: the {{cap}} new accounts allowed per hour have already been created.
system.unreadNote: (a usage count, not a problem count)
system.outboxFailed: Some events ran out of delivery attempts.
system.maintenanceReportOnly: Files on disk with no database record (a deletion that failed halfway, for example); {{grace}}. The daily sweep only reports.
system.maintenanceDeletes: Files on disk with no database record (a deletion that failed halfway, for example); {{grace}}. The daily sweep reports and also deletes.
system.verifyDescription: Looks for orphans without deleting anything. It walks the disk, so run it only when needed.
system.deleteDescription: Asks for a reason and sweeps again: it may delete a different set than the preview.
system.deleteDialog: The preview from {{when}} found {{count}} file(s) ({{size}}). On confirm, the server sweeps again and deletes what it finds. This cannot be undone.
